## About Me

Hi, I'm Alexa! I'm a marketing and operations professional based in Los Angeles, currently pursuing my M.S. in Digital Marketing and Analytics at Cal Poly Pomona.

I've worked with startups and consumer brands across music technology, toys, and Korean skincare. Right now I'm a B2C Operations & Marketing Specialist at Hamee and ByUR, where I keep things running across TikTok Shop, Shopify, Walmart, Amazon, and Target Plus. I like being the person who connects the dots between teams, and grad school is helping me get better at backing those decisions up with data.

## Career Aspirations

I'm working toward a role in operations and e-commerce where I can use analytics to improve how teams work and how customers experience a brand. I'm most interested in the space where marketing, process, and data overlap, like turning performance reports into clear next steps or making marketplace operations run more smoothly.
